# M5-S2: imported const func step limits and purity rules (T-201, T-102).
# Caller max_ctfe_steps bounds imported recursive const funcs; purity rejects
# forbidden I/O and mutable package/imported globals; ordinary imported non-const
# functions remain strictly rejected at compile time.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# 1. Purity rejects forbidden I/O in const func.
cd impure_io
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_func_impure\] I/O: call to println in const func'
cd ..

# 2. Purity rejects reading mutable package variable in const func.
cd impure_read_var
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_func_impure\] read of package variable LocalCounter in const func'
cd ..

# 3. Purity rejects writing mutable package variable in const func.
cd impure_write_var
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_func_impure\] write to package variable TargetVar in const func'
cd ..

# 4. Purity rejects reading imported mutable variable in const func.
cd impure_read_imp
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_func_impure\] read of imported variable ExportedCounter in const func'
cd ..

# 5. Ordinary imported non-const function rejected in const initializer.
cd reject_plain
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_eval\] call to imported function example\.com/reclib\.PlainAdd in const func'
cd ..

# 6. Ordinary imported non-const function rejected when called inside const func body.
cd reject_plain_body
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_func_impure\] call to imported function reclib\.PlainAdd in const func'
cd ..

# 7. Caller max_ctfe_steps limits imported recursion (Rec(1000) under limit 100).
cd caller_limit
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[comptime::ctfe_step_limit\] evaluation exceeds the step limit'
cd ..

# 8. Evaluation within caller max_ctfe_steps succeeds and runs (Rec(5) under limit 100).
cd caller_ok
logos run .
stdout '^under-limit: 5$'
cd ..

# 9. Caller max_ctfe_steps limits same-package recursion.
cd same_pkg_limit
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[comptime::ctfe_step_limit\]'
cd ..

# 10. Caller max_ctfe_steps limits recursion in comptime generic copy.
cd copy_limit
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[comptime::ctfe_step_limit\]'
cd ..

-- reclib/go.mod --
module example.com/reclib

go 1.27

-- reclib/rec.lgo --
package reclib

import "comptime"

// ExportedCounter is an exported mutable package variable.
var ExportedCounter int = 7

// Rec is a pure recursive const function.
const func Rec(n int) int {
	if n <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return 1 + Rec(n-1)
}

// PlainAdd is an ordinary non-const exported function.
func PlainAdd(a, b int) int {
	return a + b
}

// GenericSteps is a comptime generic whose copy evaluates Rec(1000).
// reclib has no logos.toml, so its definition check runs under the
// default step budget and succeeds; the caller-limit copy check in the
// importing package must enforce the selected limit.
func GenericSteps[T any]() int {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		const Limit = Rec(1000)
		return Limit + f.Index
	}
	return 0
}

-- caller_limit/go.mod --
module example.com/callerlimit

go 1.27

require example.com/reclib v0.0.0

replace example.com/reclib => ../reclib

-- caller_limit/logos.toml --
[lints.thresholds]
max_ctfe_steps = 100

-- caller_limit/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/reclib"

// Rec(1000) under caller max_ctfe_steps = 100 exceeds the step limit.
const Exceeded = reclib.Rec(1000)

func main() {
	println(Exceeded)
}

-- caller_ok/go.mod --
module example.com/callerok

go 1.27

require example.com/reclib v0.0.0

replace example.com/reclib => ../reclib

-- caller_ok/logos.toml --
[lints.thresholds]
max_ctfe_steps = 100

-- caller_ok/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/reclib"
)

// Rec(5) executes within caller max_ctfe_steps = 100.
const Under = reclib.Rec(5)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("under-limit:", Under)
}

-- impure_io/go.mod --
module example.com/impureio

go 1.27

-- impure_io/main.lgo --
package main

const func BadIO(x int) int {
	println("forbidden-io")
	return x
}

const V = BadIO(1)

func main() {
	println(V)
}

-- impure_read_var/go.mod --
module example.com/impurereadvar

go 1.27

-- impure_read_var/main.lgo --
package main

var LocalCounter int = 10

const func ReadLocal() int {
	return LocalCounter
}

const V = ReadLocal()

func main() {
	println(V)
}

-- impure_write_var/go.mod --
module example.com/impurewritevar

go 1.27

-- impure_write_var/main.lgo --
package main

var TargetVar int = 0

const func WriteLocal(x int) int {
	TargetVar = x
	return x
}

const V = WriteLocal(5)

func main() {
	println(V)
}

-- impure_read_imp/go.mod --
module example.com/impurereadimp

go 1.27

require example.com/reclib v0.0.0

replace example.com/reclib => ../reclib

-- impure_read_imp/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/reclib"

const func ReadImported() int {
	return reclib.ExportedCounter
}

const V = ReadImported()

func main() {
	println(V)
}

-- reject_plain/go.mod --
module example.com/rejectplain

go 1.27

require example.com/reclib v0.0.0

replace example.com/reclib => ../reclib

-- reject_plain/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/reclib"

// PlainAdd is not a const func: compile-time evaluation must reject it.
const BadInit = reclib.PlainAdd(3, 4)

func main() {
	println(BadInit)
}

-- reject_plain_body/go.mod --
module example.com/rejectplainbody

go 1.27

require example.com/reclib v0.0.0

replace example.com/reclib => ../reclib

-- reject_plain_body/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/reclib"

const func CallPlain() int {
	return reclib.PlainAdd(1, 2)
}

const BadBody = CallPlain()

func main() {
	println(BadBody)
}

-- same_pkg_limit/go.mod --
module example.com/samepkglimit

go 1.27

-- same_pkg_limit/logos.toml --
[lints.thresholds]
max_ctfe_steps = 100

-- same_pkg_limit/main.lgo --
package main

const func SameRec(n int) int {
	if n <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return 1 + SameRec(n-1)
}

const Exceeded = SameRec(1000)

func main() {
	println(Exceeded)
}

-- copy_limit/go.mod --
module example.com/copylimit

go 1.27

require example.com/reclib v0.0.0

replace example.com/reclib => ../reclib

-- copy_limit/logos.toml --
[lints.thresholds]
max_ctfe_steps = 100

-- copy_limit/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/reclib"

type Row struct {
	X int
}

// GenericSteps is defined in reclib (default step budget, definition
// succeeds); instantiating it here forces the caller's copy checker to
// evaluate Rec(1000) under the selected max_ctfe_steps = 100.
func main() {
	println(reclib.GenericSteps[Row]())
}
